concept.title: Making Clauses Condition-based in a Template
concept.shortdesc: You can use condition-based clauses in your template to make more customized and flexible agreement

conbody.p: You can use condition-based clauses in your template to make more customized and flexible agreement templates. The condition for the condition-based clauses can be simple or complex expressions that you can make using the expression builder. The clause conditions are evaluated at the time of agreement generation and the clause text is included in the generated document only if the associated condition resolves to True.
